summary: iter121 — E2E validated new customer Expo home experience (dynamic feed + admin CMS). Backend: /api/app/home returns 200 with correct branding, hero_slides (Home Services / Made Simple, 3 features), 7 sections in the required order (categories, offer_banner, quick_features, most_booked, why_choose, trending, offers — salon correctly omitted because no salon categories are seeded), 4 quick features, >=8 most_booked cards with id/name/base_price/rating, why_choose.title='Why Choose AzoApp?' + 5 items, 7 offers + 3 coupons, stats present. /api/app/home?city=patna also 200. Admin CMS: GET/PUT /api/admin/app-home enforces admin role (401 anon, 403 for customer, 200 for admin). Modifying why_choose.title, hero_slides[0].title and disabling `trending` immediately reflected in the public feed (cache bust works); restoring original values brought the feed back to normal. All 6 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_app_home_iter121.py. Frontend (mobile 390x844 @ http://localhost:3001): landing-page mounts, app-header renders every required testID (logo, tagline='Service at Your Doorstep', location-pill, bell (muted icon present when notification permission denied), avatar, search bar + voice mic), hero-title='Home Services', hero-cta-0='Book a Service', hero-rating visible; categories row (6 tiles + app-cat-more); app-offer-banner shows LIMITED TIME OFFER + code MONSOON20 and app-offer-copy toasts 'Code MONSOON20 copied — apply at checkout'; 4 quick features present (qf-1..4); app-most-booked with tile 0 + Book Now. Progressive load confirmed: app-why-choose/app-trending/app-offers are ABSENT on first paint and appear only after wheel-scroll (why-choose title & 5 items shown, trending & offers cards visible). Search: typing 'ac' shows app-search-results with 4 rows; app-search-all navigates to site-page-services; app-search-clear empties the field. Bottom nav: bn-book-now → site-page-services; bn-offers → offers page with 7 offers-offer-* + 3 offers-coupon-*; offers-back returns to landing-page; bn-bookings/bn-account when logged out → login; after customer login (9000000004/OTP 123456) → customer-home. Regression: partner 9000000003 correctly BLOCKED with toast 'Only Customers can sign in to the Customer App.'; session persists across page.reload (landing renders, then bn-account → customer-home without re-login). Expo Android bundle serves 200 (14.4 MB).

ui_bugs.issue: Spec calls for testIDs `app-location` (pincode input), `app-location-pincode-badge`, and `app-location-set` inside the sheet, but AppHeader reuses SiteNavbar's LocationButton which exposes `nav-location-input`, `nav-location-set`, and `nav-pincode-badge`. `app-location` is currently attached to the OUTER Pressable that only expands the inner popover — it isn't an input, so Playwright fill() fails. Rename the inner input/badge/set testIDs to `app-location`/`app-location-pincode-badge`/`app-location-set` (or accept both) so the app-home spec is honored.

After customer login, tapping bn-bookings navigated to a screen whose [data-testid="page-title"] rendered '(customer)' instead of 'My Bookings'. Root cause: expo-router landed on the /(customer) group index (not /(customer)/orders) so the [tab].tsx placeholder computed its title from the segment '(customer)'. Ensure router.push('/(customer)/orders') actually resolves to the orders tab route (or update [tab].tsx to fall back to 'My Bookings' when segment is a route-group).

action_items: (MEDIUM) Align location testIDs inside AppHeader sheet with the spec (app-location on the pincode input, app-location-set on the Set button, app-location-pincode-badge on the serviceability badge). Currently the inner popover keeps SiteNavbar's nav-* testIDs.

(MEDIUM) bn-bookings routing: after login the placeholder shows page-title '(customer)' rather than 'My Bookings' because the router settles on the /(customer) group index, not /(customer)/orders. Verify router.push target or make [tab].tsx placeholder more resilient.
critical_code_review_comments: app_home_controller.save_config busts the CACHE prefix — verified public /api/app/home reflects PUT changes immediately (why_choose title, hero title, trending enabled toggle).
app_home_controller.public_home correctly drops the `salon` section when no tabs are configured and no salon-slugged categories exist (expected behaviour for current DB).
AppHeader's bell correctly reflects notification-permission state (app-bell-muted rendered when permission=denied in the browser context).

Voice search: in the current Playwright Chromium build SpeechRecognition IS available so the mic toggles into 'Listening… speak now' toast rather than the 'not supported' error branch — no crash, both branches handled by /src/lib/voice.ts.
Progressive rendering via FlatList visibleCount+2 on onEndReached works — first paint intentionally hides why_choose/trending/offers and they mount after wheel scroll, matching spec.
Categories row renders 6 catalog tiles + 1 app-cat-more tile per spec.
seed_data_creation: none — admin config was mutated during test and restored to original values via PUT (verified via re-GET).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints exercised in /app/backend/tests/test_app_home_iter121.py (pytest -v). Public feed: /api/app/home; admin CMS: /api/admin/app-home. To run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 pytest backend/tests/test_app_home_iter121.py -v`. Frontend testIDs (RN testID → data-testid on web) verified: landing-page, app-header, app-logo, app-tagline, app-location-pill, app-bell, app-bell-muted, app-avatar, app-search-bar, app-search-input, app-voice-btn, app-search-results, app-search-result-*, app-search-all, app-search-clear, hero-title, hero-cta-0, hero-rating, app-categories, app-cat-<id>, app-cat-more, app-offer-banner, app-offer-copy, app-offer-cta, app-quick-features, app-qf-qf-1..4, app-most-booked, app-most-booked-0, app-most-booked-0-book, app-why-choose, app-trending, app-trending-*, app-offers, app-offer-<id>, offers-offer-*, offers-coupon-*, offers-copy-*, offers-back, bn-home/bn-bookings/bn-book-now/bn-offers/bn-account, toast-message. Location sheet testIDs currently mismatch (nav-location-input / nav-location-set / nav-pincode-badge inside the sheet instead of app-*). Bell muted when notification permission denied. Voice mic uses Web Speech API in Chromium (this Playwright build DOES provide SpeechRecognition → 'Listening…' toast instead of the 'not supported' error toast). Progressive scroll: move mouse over list (page.mouse.move(195,500)) then page.mouse.wheel(0,1000) several times to reveal why_choose/trending/offers. Do NOT restart the 'frontend' supervisor; the Expo dev server is under supervisor 'customer_expo'. Admin config was restored — the demo is clean.
rca of the issue: (1) Location testID mismatch: AppHeader wraps LocationButton with an outer <Pressable testID='app-location'> that expands an inner popover containing TextInput testID='nav-location-input' + Pressable testID='nav-location-set' + View testID='nav-pincode-badge'. To satisfy the app-home spec, either rename those inner testIDs to app-location/app-location-set/app-location-pincode-badge or add duplicate testIDs. (2) bn-bookings routing: router.push('/(customer)/orders') from AppBottomNav.go(target,true) apparently resolved to /(customer) index during test; the placeholder [tab].tsx then computed segment='(customer)' and printed it as title. Confirm the route file exists (it does — [tab].tsx) and the group ordering doesn't intercept the push; alternately harden the placeholder title fallback.
